sentences.en: From VOA Learning English, this is the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 从VOA学习英语, 这是健康和生活方式报告。

sentences.en: In Edmonton, Alberta, the sun had yet to come up.
sentences.zh: 在艾伯塔的埃德蒙顿 太阳尚未升起

sentences.en: The temperature was more than 20 degrees below zero.
sentences.zh: 温度在零下超过20度。

sentences.en: In the dark and cold, Tanis Smith was ready to run up and down hundreds of stairs among the trees in the Saskatchewan River Valley.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗和寒冷中,塔尼斯·史密斯准备在萨斯喀彻温河谷的树木之间上下爬上数百层楼梯。

sentences.en: And Smith was not alone. Ten people joined her for the activity.
sentences.zh: 史密斯并不孤单,有十个人加入她参加这个活动

sentences.en: All were wearing several layers of clothing to keep warm.
sentences.zh: 他们都穿着几层衣服来保暖。

sentences.en: “You're pretty much just putting everything you own on,” said Smith, an accountant. “If you look at the pictures, you don’t know who you are unless you remember what you were wearing.”
sentences.zh: 一位会计史密斯说 : “ 你只是把自己所有的东西都放进去而已 ” 。 “如果你看这些照片,除非记得你当时穿的是什么,否则你不知道自己是谁。 ”

sentences.en: Since that winter back in 2013, Smith has rarely missed a workout with a group called November Project.
sentences.zh: 自2013年冬天以来, Smith很少错过一个叫“11月计划”的团队的锻炼。

sentences.en: November Project is a network of free outdoor group exercise classes that started in Boston, Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 11月计划是由马萨诸塞州波士顿开始的免费户外集体锻炼班组成的网络。

sentences.en: No matter the weather, members get out of bed before sunrise at least once a week and go outdoors for group exercise.
sentences.zh: 不管天气如何 成员每周至少一次日出前起床 然后到户外去集体锻炼

sentences.en: November Project is part exercise, part fun, and part community.
sentences.zh: 11月的项目是部分练习, 部分乐趣, 和部分社区。

sentences.en: It is a model for exercising outdoors, especially in the winter.
sentences.zh: 它是户外锻炼的典范,特别是在冬天。

sentences.en: It started in 2011, when two friends agreed to exercise every morning for the month of November.
sentences.zh: 活动始于2011年,当时两位朋友同意在11月每天上午锻炼。

sentences.en: They were looking for accountability and motivation to help them stick to an exercise routine .
sentences.zh: 他们正在寻找问责和动机,帮助他们坚持例行工作。

sentences.en: By the end of that first month, they had invited others to join them.
sentences.zh: 在第一个月底,他们邀请了其他人加入他们。

sentences.en: Soon, their meetings were bringing in almost forty people.
sentences.zh: 很快,他们的会议就吸引了将近40人。

sentences.en: And it became a year-round project. “A party is better when there’s more people around.
sentences.zh: 它成了一个全年的项目。 “如果周围有更多的人,党会更好。

sentences.en: We would talk to anybody who would listen,” said Bojan Mandaric.
sentences.zh: ” Bojan Mandaric说,

sentences.en: He created the project with friend, Brogan Graham.
sentences.zh: 他和朋友布洛根·格雷厄姆一起创建了这个项目

sentences.en: Then, as people moved to other cities, they took the idea with them.
sentences.zh: 然后,当人们搬到其他城市时, 他们带着这个想法。

sentences.en: So, the November Project grew. Now, there are 52 groups in eight countries, including 44 in the United States and Canada.
sentences.zh: 因此,11月项目有所增长。现在,在8个国家有52个团体,包括美国和加拿大的44个。

sentences.en: What do the workouts look like? People of all ages and fitness levels join the workouts.
sentences.zh: 各种年龄和身体水平的人都参加锻炼。

sentences.en: Some groups begin with something called “The Bounce.” They chant and jump at the same time to bring the group together.
sentences.zh: 一些团体首先提出一个名为“猛击”的话题,他们同时高呼和跳跃,使该团体走到一起。

sentences.en: Those who feel inhibited , do not have to do this.
sentences.zh: 那些觉得受抑制的人, 不必这样做。

sentences.en: Most classes include running and body weight exercises like squats .
sentences.zh: 多数课程包括像蹲地一样的跑步和体重练习。

sentences.en: The project also uses the surroundings of the location.
sentences.zh: 该项目还利用该地点的周围环境。

sentences.en: So, for example, some places include running up steps in an outdoor sports stadium .
sentences.zh: 例如,有些地方包括户外运动场的台阶。

sentences.en: Currently in D.C., members meet on Wednesdays to run up the steps of the Lincoln Memorial.
sentences.zh: 目前,成员们在华盛顿星期三开会,讨论林肯纪念馆的台阶。

sentences.en: To keep the workouts fun, they also might include fun games and activities from childhood.
sentences.zh: 为了保持锻炼的乐趣, 他们也可以包括有趣的游戏和活动 从童年起。

sentences.en: In Edmonton, they play snow games in winter and water games in summer.
sentences.zh: 在埃德蒙顿,他们在冬季玩雪游戏,在夏季玩水游戏。

sentences.en: The games help to lower inhibitions. This helps people make connections, said Jason Shaw.
sentences.zh: Jason Shaw说,游戏有助于减少抑制。这可以帮助人们建立联系。

sentences.en: He is co-leader of the Indianapolis, Indiana group.
sentences.zh: 他是印第安纳波利斯集团的共同领导人。

sentences.en: “Nobody (is) cool at November Project,” he said.
sentences.zh: 他说,“11月项目没有人(是)酷。

sentences.en: Shaw said groups recognize members’ milestones .
sentences.zh: Shaw说,各团体承认成员的里程碑。

sentences.en: People can earn prizes for reaching different goals.
sentences.zh: 人们可以因为达到不同的目标而获得奖赏。

sentences.en: To find out if a November Project group is near you, go to their website at November-Project.com .
sentences.zh: 了解11月项目组是否接近你,请访问11月-11月项目.com的网站。

sentences.en: Building community and making friends is another big part of the project.
sentences.zh: 建立社群和交朋友是该项目的另一个重要部分。

sentences.en: So, each group is active on social media.
sentences.zh: 因此,每个团体都在社交媒体上活跃。

sentences.en: If you do not have a November Project nearby, you can find another type of outdoor exercise group.
sentences.zh: 如果您在附近没有“11月计划”,您可以找到另一种户外运动组。

sentences.en: Or start your own. The November Project organizers offer a few suggestions on how to work out during colder months.
sentences.zh: 11月计划组织者提出一些建议,

sentences.en: Find workout friends Find workout friends.
sentences.zh: 找健身朋友 找健身朋友

sentences.en: At the center of the project, is accountability.
sentences.zh: 该项目的核心是问责制。

sentences.en: Members promise to show up. There is a sense of letting down your teammates if you do not show up, said Mandaric, who moved to Boston from Serbia to row crew for Northeastern University. (Rowing crew is a type of boat racing.)
sentences.zh: 普通话说,如果你们不出现,就会让队友失望。 普通话说,他们从塞尔维亚搬到波士顿,到东北大学去划船。 (轮船船员是赛船的一种类型。 )

sentences.en: Invest in some cold-weather clothing There is no such thing as bad weather, just bad clothing, said Shaw, the leader from Indianapolis.
sentences.zh: 投资一些冷天衣 没有什么像坏天气, 只是坏衣服, Shaw说,印第安纳波利斯的领袖。

sentences.en: He suggests wearing clothing next to your skin that removes sweat .
sentences.zh: 他建议穿衣服在你皮肤旁边 消除汗水。

sentences.en: This will help keep you warm and dry. Avoid cotton, he warned.
sentences.zh: 这会帮助你保持温暖和干燥 避免棉花,他警告过你

sentences.en: It keeps sweat in contact with your body and will make you colder.
sentences.zh: 它保持汗 与你的身体接触 并会让你更冷。

sentences.en: Also, add a top layer that protects against bad weather.
sentences.zh: 另外,增加一个顶层 防止坏天气。

sentences.en: On its webpage, the November Project leaders for Washington, DC say workouts are not cancelled for weather.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿11月项目领导人在网站上表示,

sentences.en: Make it a usual activity Promise yourself to exercise on the same days and times for a month.
sentences.zh: 保证自己在同一个日子和时间运动一个月。

sentences.en: Create a routine. This will make it easier to stick to an exercise routine, says Mandaric.
sentences.zh: 普通话说,这样可以更容易地坚持练习。

sentences.en: Make it fun And make sure to have fun. Exercise does not have to be hard or serious.
sentences.zh: 玩得开心 玩得开心点 锻炼不必太辛苦或严肃

sentences.en: Smith, the member from Edmonton, Alberta, says she enjoys the social part of the November Project the most.
sentences.zh: 艾伯塔的Edmonton成员Smith说,她最享受十一月计划的社会部分。

sentences.en: She calls it “a chosen family.” They came together because they had fun exercising.
sentences.zh: 她称之为“一个选择的家庭 ” 。 他们聚集在一起是因为他们玩得很开心。

sentences.en: She said. “You can have fun and get fit.” And that’s the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 她说 : “ 你可以玩得开心,可以适应。 ”这是《健康与生活方式报告》。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. Albert Stumm reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Anna Matteo, Albert Stumm 向美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: Anna Matteo adapted it into a lesson for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Anna Matteo改编为VOA学习英语课程。
